verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for an API platform like Yapily, so the axis applies. However, the only documented authentication is HTTP Basic Auth with an Application ID and Application Secret, with no evidence of scoped, least-privilege, or agent-specific keys. End-user consent tokens control bank-data access, not the permissions of an API credential, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
